question: Do actual run-block pairs retain useful position between their defender and the ballcarrier at the carrier's observed arrival, separately from merely retaining an engagement?
physics: Accepted default inputs and the separate directional-bracing candidate; actual engine source is recorded. No profile, request, controller, joint or World intervention by this collector.
arrival: First sampled live crossing of the LOS, and separately of each pair's moving longitudinal midpoint, by an offensive ballcarrier other than the QB. Crossings are bracketed at controller ticks; no substep arrival time is inferred.
interposition: Signed nominal blocker-radius minus perpendicular distance to the defender-to-actual-carrier segment, only when the blocker projects strictly inside that segment. This circular-profile proxy does not reconstruct squeeze-dependent collision support. Positive means geometric interception of that direct centerline, not certified approach protection or causal prevention of a tackle.
scope: Observed executed paths only; no hypothetical alternate lanes, block-win threshold, NFL rate or causal counterfactual. Proximity/reach are explicitly separate from nonzero hand load, torso impulse and acquired tackle grip. A live prefix and a wall/error censor are retained explicitly.
